## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Codex「直连 API」桌面实例无法开始对话的问题：启动时明确设置 API 登录模式，并在供应商模型未收录于客户端内置目录时，为该实例生成隔离的模型目录。OAuth 原生账号不受影响。
- 停止实例时恢复原始配置；API 登录模式和模型目录均纳入可恢复的配置事务，不改写其他实例或默认 Codex 配置。
- 扩展真实客户端隔离烟测，验证原生 API 会话请求到达配置的 Responses 服务并成功返回；原生 CLI 回归验证 API 凭据、Responses、Fast 和 Flex 请求。

- Fixes Codex desktop instances that could not start conversations in direct API mode. Launch now explicitly selects API authentication and creates an instance-scoped model catalog when the provider model is missing from the client's bundled catalog. Native OAuth accounts are unchanged.
- Stopping an instance restores its original configuration. API mode and the model catalog are managed by the recoverable config transaction, without changing other instances or the default Codex profile.
- Extends isolated real-client smoke coverage to verify native API conversation requests reach the configured Responses service and return successfully. Native CLI regression also verifies API credentials, Responses, Fast and Flex requests.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时请保留后台服务，待工作结束、管理器完全退出后切换新版；账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。未提供应用内自动更新、Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构未经验证。

DMG / ZIP and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64). Keep background services running during active work and switch after the manager fully exits; accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app auto-update, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures are not validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

延续 Codex 桌面 / CLI、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 支持，客户端需单独安装。本次修复限定于 Codex Responses API 连接，不代表供应商模型或真实付费上游服务均通过验收。

Continues support for Codex desktop / CLI, Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop, installed separately. This fix is specific to Codex Responses API connections; it does not claim every provider model or real paid upstream service was tested.

## 验证来源 / Verification

使用 Codex Desktop 26.1027.61615、隔离 profile、合成 API Key 和本机模拟 Responses 服务验证可输入、普通对话请求及回复。使用当前客户端内置 CLI 和 loopback 服务验证 API 凭据、Fast=`priority`、Flex 与 API endpoint 切换。完整测试、构建和打包结果以此版本流水线为准。

Tested Codex Desktop 26.1027.61615 with a disposable profile, synthetic API key and local mock Responses service, verifying the composer, normal conversation request and reply. Tested the bundled CLI against a loopback service for API credentials, Fast=`priority`, Flex and endpoint switching. The version-matched release workflow records the full regression, build and packaging results.

源码见 [v0.15.24 标签 / source tag](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.15.24)，构建见 [Build release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml)，摘要见 [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.15.24/SHA256SUMS.txt)。
